messages:
maya: Quick question — prepping to promote staging -> prod overlays for payments svc. I moved the secret path in TF PR #5283 from /staging/payments/ to /prod/payments/. CI plan looked clean but want a quick sanity check on release-gate steps and any KMS/rotation gotchas. Who can eyeball?

jonas: I skimmed the TF plan. Main thing: state move + new resource name. Make sure you ran `terraform state mv` in the plan run or used the resource alias in the module. Also double-check the secretsmanager ARN namespace in kustomize.

jonas: Example commands I used recently:```
terraform init -backend-config=backend.staging.hcl
terraform plan -var-file=staging.tfvars
# if renaming
terraform state mv aws_secretsmanager_secret.old_secret_name aws_secretsmanager_secret.prod_secret_name
```

lee: @maya is the kustomize overlay adding the secretRef with the prod path? If the pod spec still references staging secret name, it will blow up on deploy.

maya: yes — overlay patch sets envFrom: secretRef.name: payments-prod-creds in overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml. I pushed that in the same PR.

oliver: Two quick gating checks: 1) release-gate CI job should include a preflight that verifies secret ARN exists and is accessible from prod role (IAM/KMS). 2) Canary policy: promote 10% traffic for 15m with auto-rollback. If KMS key rotation happened recently, add a manual decrypt test in the preflight.

maya: where is the decrypt test hook? I can add a tiny job.

jonas: we have a lightweight script in infra/scripts/check-secret.sh that does `aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --secret-id $ID --region $REGION | jq -r .SecretString` — add it to release-gate preflight step. Also add `--kms-key-id` check with `aws kms describe-key`.

deploy-bot: CI: release-gate/preflight — passed (all checks green). build/5283 — plan ok, no changes to compute.

lee: one more: make sure pointer in workload identity (IRSA) mapping updated for prod namespace if you changed role name. We had a subtle RBAC issue last month.

maya: thanks all. I'll add the decrypt script to preflight, confirm the IRSA mapping, and kick off a manual promote. Will ping here when promote job starts.

oliver: If you want, tag @oncall in the promote command so SRE can watch logs (`/promote --tag oncall`). Also set canary-window=900s.

maya: noted. kicking off in ~10m. thanks :thumbsup:
